subject.title: docs(install): add vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide

question: Should OpenClaw accept a vendor-neutral NVIDIA Jetson install guide in first-party docs after the NVIDIA setup guidance is repaired?
rationale: The code/docs repair is mechanical, but the linked issue explicitly asks for maintainer policy on first-party hardware docs and turnkey hardware references, which automation cannot decide.

options.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
options.body: Land a vendor-neutral Jetson guide once the JetPack/SD-card guidance matches current NVIDIA docs and commercial hardware references stay out of the page.

options.title: Route Jetson Guidance Outside Core Docs
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep Jetson-specific setup in vendor, community, or ClawHub surfaces instead of first-party OpenClaw docs.

options.title: Narrow To Generic ARM Hardware
options.body: Ask for a smaller generic ARM hardware note if maintainers do not want a dedicated NVIDIA-branded install page.

recommendation.title: Accept After Source-Backed Repair
recommendation.body: Land a vendor-neutral Jetson guide once the JetPack/SD-card guidance matches current NVIDIA docs and commercial hardware references stay out of the page.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is about first-party docs scope and ClawHub/vendor promotion policy, which aligns with the VISION and related close history tied to this owner.
